            "text": "- **Framework**: Next.js 14 (App Router)",
            "lineNumber": 224
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Language**: TypeScript 5.3",
            "lineNumber": 225
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS 3.4",
            "lineNumber": 226
          },
          {
            "text": "- **3D**: React Three Fiber 8.15 + Three.js 0.160",
            "lineNumber": 227
          },
          {
            "text": "- **State**: Zustand 4.4",
            "lineNumber": 228
          },
          {
            "text": "- **UI**: shadcn/ui + Lucide icons",
            "lineNumber": 229
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 230
          },
          {
            "text": "### バックエンド",
            "lineNumber": 231
          },
          {
            "text": "- **BaaS**: Supabase (Auth, Database, Storage, Functions)",
            "lineNumber": 232
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Database**: PostgreSQL 15",
            "lineNumber": 233
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Storage**: S3-compatible",
            "lineNumber": 234
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Functions**: Deno Edge Functions",
            "lineNumber": 235
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 236
          },
          {
            "text": "### AI/LLM",
            "lineNumber": 237
          },
          {
            "text": "- **OpenAI**: GPT-5 Codex (Pro), GPT-5 High (Medium), GPT-5 Mini",
            "lineNumber": 238
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Anthropic**: Claude 4.5 Sonnet, Claude 4.5 Haiku, Claude 4.1 Opus",
            "lineNumber": 239
          },
          {
            "text": "- **統合**: 統一インターフェース（Provider抽象化、ストリーミング対応）",
            "lineNumber": 240
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 241
          },
          {
            "text": "### インフラ",
            "lineNumber": 242
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Hosting**: Vercel (Serverless)",
            "lineNumber": 243
          },
          {
            "text": "- **DNS**: Cloudflare",
            "lineNumber": 244
          },
          {
            "text": "- **CDN**: Vercel Edge Network",
            "lineNumber": 245
          },
          {
            "text": "- **SSL**: Let's Encrypt (auto)",
            "lineNumber": 246
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 247
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 248
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 249
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🎯 差別化ポイント",
            "lineNumber": 250
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 251
          },
          {
            "text": "### vs Cursor",
            "lineNumber": 252
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 253
          },
          {
            "text": "| 項目 | Prism | Cursor |",
            "lineNumber": 254
          },
          {
            "text": "|------|-------|--------|",
            "lineNumber": 255
          },
          {
            "text": "| **3D可視化** | ✅ 50K@35FPS | ❌ |",
            "lineNumber": 256
          },
          {
            "text": "| **Multi-LLM** | ✅ OpenAI + Claude | ⚠️ 限定的 |",
            "lineNumber": 257
          },
          {
            "text": "| **コスト** | ✅ Free (BYOK) | $20/月 |",
            "lineNumber": 258
          },
          {
            "text": "| **Claude統合** | ✅ MCP Server | ⚠️ Built-in |",
            "lineNumber": 259
          },
          {
            "text": "| **オープンソース** | ✅ Apache 2.0 | ❌ |",
            "lineNumber": 260
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 261
          },
          {
            "text": "**結論**: 可視化力圧倒、マルチLLM、完全無料",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 263
          },
          {
            "text": "### vs kamui4d",

          },

          {

        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# Prism - AI-Native Code Intelligence Platform",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "**プロダクト名**: Prism  ",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "**バージョン**: 1.0.0  ",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "**ライセンス**: Apache 2.0",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🎯 概要",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "PrismはKamui4d超えの3D/4D Git可視化とマルチLLM対応（OpenAI + Anthropic Claude）を統合した、次世代コードインテリジェンスプラットフォームです。",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "### 主要機能",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "- 🌟 **3D/4D Git可視化**: 50,000コミット@35FPS",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "- 🤖 **マルチLLM対応**: OpenAI GPT-4 + Anthropic Claude 3",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "- 🔌 **Claude Code統合**: MCP Server経由",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "- 🔐 **完全無料**: Supabase無料枠で構築",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "- 💰 **BYOK方式**: ユーザー自身のAPIキー使用",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "## 🚀 クイックスタート",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "### 前提条件",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "- Node.js 18以上",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "- npm or pnpm",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "- OpenAI APIキー or Anthropic APIキー",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "### インストール",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "# Clone repository",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "git clone https://github.com/zapabob/prism-web.git",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "cd prism-web",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "# Install dependencies",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "npm install",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "# Set up environment variables",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "cp .env.example .env.local",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "# Edit .env.local with your Supabase credentials",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "# Run development server",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "npm run dev",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "### Supabaseセットアップ",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "1. https://supabase.com でプロジェクト作成",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "2. SQL Editorで &#96;supabase/schema.sql&#96; 実行",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "3. Settings → API から URL と Anon Keyをコピー",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "4. &#96;.env.local&#96; に設定",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL=https://xxx.supabase.co",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=eyJxxx...",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "ENCRYPTION_SECRET=your-32-char-secret-key-here",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "## 📁 プロジェクト構造",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "prism-web/",
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "├── app/                    # Next.js 14 App Router",
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "text": "│   ├── (auth)/            # 認証ページ",
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "text": "│   ├── (dashboard)/       # ダッシュボード",
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "text": "│   └── (public)/          # 公開ページ",
            "lineNumber": 71
          },
          {
            "text": "├── components/            # Reactコンポーネント",
            "lineNumber": 72
          },
          {
            "text": "│   ├── ui/               # shadcn/ui components",
            "lineNumber": 73
          },
          {
            "text": "│   ├── visualizations/   # 3D可視化",
            "lineNumber": 74
          },
          {
            "text": "│   └── chat/             # AIチャット",
            "lineNumber": 75
          },
          {
            "text": "├── lib/                  # ユーティリティ",
            "lineNumber": 76
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.38882699608802795

            "text": "//! Plan schema definitions",

          },
          {
            "text": "//! Defines the core data structures for plan mode, including the",

          },

          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "//! The &#96;PlanBlock&#96; structure captures the structured output from the official Plan Mode",

            "lineNumber": 11

          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },

            "text": "//! - Materially change the spec/plan, OR",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },

            "text": "//! - Confirm/lock an assumption, OR",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "//! - Choose between meaningful tradeoffs",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "//!",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "//! Questions should be batched (4-10 per interaction) to maintain momentum, following",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "//! the official Plan Mode improvements from commits #9877 and #9874.",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 22
          },
